limits: warm exact cohorts do not prove all-scenario/all-metric superiority
current successful reads, strict decode/shape/count/scope checks precede whole proof reuse
cold/mismatched/poison/oversize paths still compute the complete scoped hash
in-flight already admitted dependency pins can survive eviction until the active reader finishes
whole-process memory includes Python/runtime/allocator and is distinct from conservative cache accounting
native C ABI timings exclude Python/GIL; SDK timings include decoding and caller delivery

broader doc/architecture failures compared against unchanged pre-existing baseline separately
